editorNote: Duolingo's post-earnings jump, gold's post-midterm move and Alphabet's Wednesday rally led the day. Several items here rest on headlines alone, so details are limited to what the outlets reported.

stories.headline: Duolingo stock soars 26% on user growth and monetization plans, Yahoo Finance reports
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance's headline reports a 26% jump on Wednesday, a day after third-quarter results; The Motley Fool also ran a piece on the surge, and Investing.com says BofA raised its price target.
stories.whyItMatters: This is the market reaction to results the paper reported yesterday.

sourceLinks.title: Duolingo stock soars 26% on strong user growth, monetization plans - Yahoo Finance
Why Duolingo Stock Skyrocketed Today - The Motley Fool
BofA raises Duolingo stock price target on user growth strength - Investing.com

stories.headline: Gold rises 2.83% on November 4, USA Today reports, as bullion rallies after US midterms
stories.summary: USA Today's headline puts the gain at 2.83% on November 4; Investing.com ties gains to a softer dollar and lower Treasury yields after the midterms, and investingLive says $4,200 remains a major hurdle.
stories.whyItMatters: The move follows two sessions when gold was reported below $4,000.

sourceLinks.title: Gold Price Today: Gold Rises 2.83% on November 04, 2026 - USA Today
Gold gains amid softer dollar, Treasury yields after U.S. midterms - Investing.com
Gold price recovery gathers pace after US midterms but $4,200 remains a major hurdle - investingLive

stories.headline: Why Alphabet stock popped on Wednesday, The Motley Fool asks
stories.summary: The Motley Fool published an explainer on Alphabet's Wednesday gain. Separately, Bloomberg's headline says Alphabet's search dominance is at risk from its own AI success.
stories.whyItMatters: Alphabet's shares were reported down about 10% since earnings in a Morningstar piece, so Wednesday's move is a partial reversal in context.

sourceLinks.title: Why Alphabet Stock Popped on Wednesday - The Motley Fool

stories.headline: Bitcoin trades near $79,600 as oil rebounds and the Bank of England hikes rates, Bitcoin Magazine says
stories.summary: Bitcoin Magazine's headline gives the price near $79,600 and links it to an oil rebound and a Bank of England rate hike.
stories.whyItMatters: Yesterday's coverage had bitcoin dipping below $76,000, so this is a recovery.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $79,600 as Oil Rebounds and Bank of England Hikes Rates - Bitcoin Magazine

stories.headline: Block's bitcoin gross profit falls by half and it sets aside $764 million for a proposed DOJ resolution, Yahoo Finance says
stories.summary: The Yahoo Finance headline reports both the halving of Block's bitcoin gross profit and a $764 million provision for a proposed Justice Department resolution.
stories.whyItMatters: The headline is the only detail gathered; terms of the resolution are not given here.

sourceLinks.title: Block’s Bitcoin Gross Profit Falls by Half, Sets Aside $764 Million for Proposed DOJ Resolution - Yahoo Finance

stories.headline: Alibaba up 6% alongside a sharp China equity rally, Kalkine reports
stories.summary: Kalkine's headline says Alibaba's NYSE shares rose 6% as Chinese equities rallied; Moomoo separately says Hong Kong shares were up 4%.
stories.whyItMatters: The gain extends a week in which Alibaba's Apple Intelligence deal was already in focus.
